name: personal-image-host
description: Minimal personal image host — Rust/Wasm Worker + R2 + D1 + Turnstile + TypeScript

scripts.build:assets: bun run build.mjs && bun run build.mjs --userscript
scripts.build: bun run build:assets && bun run build:worker
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: bun run build:assets && bunx wrangler dev
scripts.dev:cron: bun run build:assets && bunx wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply personal-image-host --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply personal-image-host --remote
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run check:contract && bun run build
